title: Mitochondrial DNA mutations are associated with impaired oxidative phosphorylation and enhanced imatinib response in chronic myeloid leukemia.

title: Dynamic multimodal survival prediction in multiple myeloma integrating gene expression, longitudinal laboratory measurements, and treatment history.
